verdict.rationale: OpenTofu defines infrastructure automations as human-readable configuration that is meant to be versioned like code (gh-2, docs-28, docs-16). It supports review through `tofu plan` previews, speculative plans run before code review, and saved plan files that are applied exactly as reviewed (docs-3, docs-4, docs-21). The versioning itself depends on an external VCS, and no first-party rollback capability is documented. missing for 10: documented rollback/revert of applied changes, built-in versioning or state history not reliant on external VCS, independent or hands-on corroboration of the review workflow.
